review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Separate human terminal scrollback from machine-current evidence; expose truthful cached-list retry state and per-thumbnail measured uploads
review.notes: User confirmed pane10; read-only observation found alternate_on1/history1224/current48/history_limit50000. Restore only viewer CapturePaneColor history, retaining CaptureFull/FullColor alternate boundary for delivery authority. Preserve snapshots while reader is away from live tail. Background fleet refresh must not lock manual retry as perpetual Updating; preserve cached rows/timestamp, refusal rules and identity scope. User supersedes aggregate attachment row with thumbnail progress; real byte fractions only, saving is not completion, failures retain draft/attachments and explicit retry goes through existing guarded send. No new dependency, local product build, real pane input or submitted Store183 change. Tests below are planned, not execution passes; independent product review will be requested through HQ after frozen head.

cases.description: Terminal viewer retains real bounded pane history while alternate-screen machine evidence stays current-only
cases.setup: Private tmux socket and synthetic ANSI normal history followed by alternate screen, existing boundary fixture; never live pane10
cases.action: Read viewer and verifier captures in alternate/normal/alternate transitions and quote-delimited target names
cases.expected: Viewer contains existing OLD-NORMAL plus current green frame with trailing rows; verifiers exclude old history, retain current frame; history_size unchanged, invalid targets empty and names cannot inject commands

cases.description: Native terminal history remains readable beyond gesture thaw timer
cases.setup: Production NativeTerm, fake timers, captured old lines and deferred newer shorter frame
cases.action: Drag away from live tail, release, deliver polls and advance beyond3.5seconds; explicitly jump to live tail
cases.expected: Old history and selection remain until reader returns; live-tail action flushes newest pending frame promptly; no timer silently replaces historical snapshot

cases.description: Cached Radar timeout is distinct from background refresh and manual retry
cases.setup: Production AgentsProvider/RadarPanel with cached fleet, rejected/timed-out read, SSE reconnect and controlled subsequent responses
cases.action: Reconnect before list read succeeds, retry explicitly, fail/timeout retry, switch clients, then recover
cases.expected: Cached roster and successful-update timestamp retained; warning explains cached list; automatic read does not disable Retry or show user-action spinner; explicit retry busy only until its bounded completion; success removes warning, old-client results cannot leak and owner/guest access errors keep restrictions

cases.description: Each thumbnail owns measured upload phase and accessible progress without standalone bar
cases.setup: Shared production Composer/status component, multiple images and controlled phase callbacks; reduced motion both states
cases.action: Queue, prepare, report37percent/62percent, process body, complete one file, fail later file and explicitly retry send
cases.expected: Status is inside each corresponding thumbnail; queued/preparing/saving never fake0or100; complete check only after saved path; actual fractions bound animation; reduce motion skips timing; failed image offers guarded retry sending while caption/images remain, no automatic upload or send
